judged_text: Google createEvent now resolves its calendar purely by matching `cal.credentialId === credentialId`, so for destinationCalendar entries without a credentialId — the path createAllCalendarEvents explicitly supports via its else branch — no entry matches and the event falls back to `calendarId: selectedCalendar || "primary"` (or duplicates another destination's calendar when a same-type credentialed destination exists). Bookings with legacy credential-less destination calendars now create their Google event on the account's primary calendar instead of the selected destination externalId (the pre-refactor behavior), placing events on the wrong calendar.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, `createEvent(calEventRaw, credentialId)` now selects `calendarId` via `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`, falling back to `"primary"` when no match is found. In `packages/core/EventManager.ts#createAllCalendarEvents`, the `else` branch explicitly supports `DestinationCalendar` entries without `credentialId` by mapping over credentials of matching `destination.integration` and calling `createEvent(c, event)` (no externalId is passed into GoogleCalendarService, and the selection logic ignores `externalId` unless `credentialId` matches). Therefore, for credential-less destinationCalendar entries (legacy/explicitly supported by this diff), Google will not find a matching calendar and will insert into the primary calendar, which is a behavior regression from the prior `destinationCalendar.externalId` selection.
